apps.localizedDescription:
The name's from emporos, ancient Greek for a traveler riding on someone else's ship.

Import a game and play it:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d19e44ff-c2ef-435f-b2fe-60f1c97890c8

Library view:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1a6de8a7-b47c-4ad4-8df9-f028347dfb9c

Highlights:

• Plays games made for RGSS1 (XP), RGSS2 (VX), RGSS3 (VX Ace), modern mkxp-z forks, PSDK, and RPG Maker MV and MZ.
• Imports games from folders or archives (.zip, .7z, .rar, JoiPlay's .jgp, self-extractable .exe).
• On-screen D-pad and action buttons you can move and resize. Layouts can differ per game and per screen orientation.
• Pause and resume from the library.
• Library with sort, search, grid/list views, and bulk delete.

Status:

Pre-release. Not on the App Store.

versions.localizedDescription:
Bug Fixes:

• Move sheet actions into the iPhone Duo side column (#237) (7925256).
• Keep the backup and layout profile rows in text colors, not brand orange (#240) (41ee259).
• Keep an imported game from reaching files outside its folder (#246) (9d8e4dc).

• The black screen after PikaTaxi in Pokémon Insurgence (mateo-m/mkxp-z-apple-mobile#70) (b4148a6).
• Find a file written after launch when an older file has the same name (mateo-m/mkxp-z-apple-mobile#69) (aac5fa4).
• Track the main branch of litergss2 (mateo-m/psdk-apple-mobile#7) (63dce27).

CI:

• Run pull requests on GitHub Macs with a build cache (#248) (34e3440).

Chores:

• Update AppAuth, swift-crypto, SDL, and web tools (#242) (62b6c6a).
• Bump version to 0.11.0 (build 825) (7fd87d5).

Features:

• Give games the Empo version in $userAgentVersion (#226) (eba5906).
• Add a setting to respect silent mode (#233) (1e58b18).
• Let players import a sound set for MIDI music (#234) (c0def1a).
• Pick a MIDI sound set for each game (#236) (49e2c35).
• Back up saves and games to iCloud Drive, Dropbox, and Google Drive (#189) (9239a49).
• Announce backups, MIDI music, and silent mode in What's new (#241) (acfb014).
• Give games the launcher version in $userAgentVersion (mateo-m/mkxp-z-apple-mobile#66) (983c900).
• Play MIDI with a static FluidSynth and a bundled SoundFont (mateo-m/mkxp-z-apple-mobile#68) (36871c6).

Other:

• Update the core and ANGLE pins (#243) (3481c65).

Refactor:

• Reorganize What's new (#249) (bf002a6).

iPhone and iPad: install the app with a sideloading tool. Install Empo on an iPhone or iPad shows how.

Mac: macOS blocks the app the first time you open it. Install Empo on a Mac shows how to allow it.
